info.title: HighwayRollersRandomizer
info.author: luamaxxing
info.details:
A mod inspired by the Wii Party equivalent (Board Game Island Randomizer by Dorian15)

/!\ This is a plugin made for Aroma, and it only works for the North America (NTSC-U) version of the game

Shuffles the positions of all of the spaces, randomizing the board every time you play.

To enable it, open Wii Party U and find it in your Aroma plugin manager. (L + D-Pad Down + Minus)

AI use: AI-assisted.
